ad_intro:
Scaler (scaler.com) is a Edtech/Coach brand running ~40 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.1-2 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Tech-upskilling platform (InterviewBit) with a strong placements story.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: alumni story ugc thin, offer-led - The gap: topper-result / alumni-story Reels. (2) Landing page: paid traffic lands on a generic course-catalog page with no exam-specific page, no topper reviews above the fold, and an OTP-only signup gate. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
~40 ads + Rs.1-2 Cr/mo = consistent mid-tier spender.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Alumni story UGC thin, offer-led. The gap: topper-result / alumni-story Reels.
Copy leak: Current angle is offer-led. Missing angle: career-outcome and topper case studies instead of free-class/discount hooks.
Landing page leak: Paid traffic lands on a generic course-catalog page with no exam-specific page, no topper reviews above the fold, and an OTP-only signup gate.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
competitors: Scales topper-AIR result Reels + faculty UGC; ~Rs.5-10 Cr/mo Meta spend.
Topper-UGC is the winning format in test prep.
Pitch efficiency and consolidation, not more spend.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy topper-result / alumni-story Reels
Shoot 15 fifteen-second topper-result / alumni-story Reels and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Build one landing page per exam/batch with topper counts + reviews above the fold, a sticky Enroll CTA, and an email option alongside OTP. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
